title: Christmas Wishlist
description: Christmas is a time for little wishes and big smiles. Here is a collection of gift ideas that would make this Christmas extra special.

gifts.name: Wooden Learning Tower
gifts.shortDescription: A little helper’s place at the kitchen counter.
gifts.description: A sturdy wooden learning tower that lets little ones safely join in with everyday kitchen moments. A thoughtful, practical gift that can grow with the family.

gifts.name: The Little Prince
gifts.shortDescription: A timeless story to read together, again and again.
gifts.description: A beautifully illustrated edition of a much-loved classic, perfect for bedtime reading and discovering something new with every reread.

gifts.name: Watercolor Art Set
gifts.shortDescription: Everything for a quiet afternoon of making and imagining.
gifts.description: A gentle starter set for painting, drawing and letting imagination wander. Look for child-friendly paints, a small palette, brushes and a pad of watercolor paper.

gifts.name: Balance Bike
gifts.shortDescription: For fresh-air adventures and wobbly first rides.
gifts.description: A lightweight balance bike encourages confidence, coordination and outdoor play. Check the recommended child height and adjustable seat range before choosing a model.

gifts.name: Reading Nook Cushion
gifts.shortDescription: A soft little spot for books, daydreams and rest.
gifts.description: A generously sized floor cushion can turn a quiet corner into a cozy reading nook. Choose a durable, washable cover in a warm neutral shade.

gifts.name: Knitted Winter Scarf
gifts.shortDescription: A soft, snug layer for chilly winter walks.
gifts.description: A cozy knitted scarf in a classic winter shade to keep little shoulders warm on cold-weather outings. Choose a soft, easy-care yarn in the right length for your child.

gifts.name: Wooden Music Box
gifts.shortDescription: A keepsake-sized melody for a bedside table.
gifts.description: A small keepsake music box adds a little wonder to a bedroom shelf. Look for a sturdy wooden finish and a gentle, familiar tune.
